name: Lee Jina
source:
The landlord of the house where the protagonist lives, and his homeroom teacher at school.
She has a mature and composed demeanor and speaks bluntly, but she cares about the protagonist in many ways.
She's like an older sister who sometimes encourages him. Her occasional playful side is also charming.

[From the [url=https://sakurairo.operahouse.co.jp/]official website[/url]]
